notes: Every harness loads his promoted skills unmodified at `commit` from one checkout, kept by `scripts/reconcile-mattpocock-skills.sh` at `~/.local/share/mattpocock-skills`. The promoted skills are the directories with a `SKILL.md` directly under the checkout's `skills/engineering` and `skills/productivity`; `skills/in-progress`, `skills/misc` and `skills/deprecated` are not promoted and do not load.

Pi lists the two directories in `skills` of `~/.pi/agent/settings.json`. Claude Code (`~/.claude/skills`) and OpenCode (`~/.config/opencode/skills`) get one symlink per promoted skill, named for the skill, pointing into the checkout. His Claude Code plugin is not used: it namespaces every skill and moves its own pin.

In Pi his copy of a name wins once no copy of that name is in `~/.agents/skills` or `~/.pi/agent/skills`; started from `~` (or a non-Git directory under it), Pi reads `~/.agents/skills` as project skills and a copy there wins. No skill in the skill pool shares a name with his, and the reconciler warns about any copy that does.
`commit` is the only place the pin lives; the reconciler reads it from here.

No adapted copy of his skills remains. Local `code-review` retired on 2026-11-16, and the six adapted copies (`grilling`, `wayfinder`, `tdd`, `diagnosing-bugs`, `codebase-architecture` for his `codebase-design` and `improve-codebase-architecture`, `guided-learning` for his `teach`) retired the same day in favour of his.

What sits on top of or under his skills here: the Forgejo adapter (`dot-agents/forgejo-tracker/scripts/forgejo_wayfinder.py`, run as `forgejo-map` from `dot-agents/bin/`, linked onto PATH by `scripts/reconcile-agent-commands.sh`) and the tracker doc template `dot-agents/forgejo-tracker/issue-tracker-forgejo.md`, which a Forgejo workspace copies to `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` so his `wayfinder` and other tracker-using skills reach its issues; `teammate-pr-review`, which loads his `code-review` for Standards and Spec only and adds the Risk and Ponytail passes and Bryan's drafting and posting rules; and `pr-self-review`'s review contract (`references/review-contract.md`), which `ship`, `multiagent-pr-review` and the Claude dimension-reviewer agents follow.
Bryan's overrides where his skills clash with Bryan's rules are in `dot-pi/agent/AGENTS.md`.

updatePolicy.description: The pi-bots scheduled job `mattpocock-skill-watch` runs weekly. When his repository's `main` is ahead of `commit`, it lists the promoted skills added, removed and changed, writes the new `commit`, `version` and `verifiedOn` here, runs `scripts/reconcile-mattpocock-skills.sh --apply`, and checks that Pi loads every promoted skill from the checkout and nothing else from it. On a pass it commits this file alone to `main`, signed, and announces the advance in Matrix with the rollback. On a failure it puts the old pin back and commits nothing. Bryan chose automatic advance with no review step on 2026-11-16.
